name: BrightBean Chat
description: Self-hosted chat automation: build visual flows and run them on Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram, SMS and email, with a shared inbox, broadcasts and drip sequences. Includes a private PostgreSQL database and background worker.

settings.label: Outgoing email
settings.description: Optional. Used for sign-up confirmation, password resets and invitations; without it the app still works.

fields.label: SMTP host
fields.help: Leave empty to skip outgoing email.

fields.label: Keep sign-up open after the first account
fields.help: Off: the first account becomes the owner and sign-up then closes. On: anyone who can reach the site can create their own organization.

services.name: brightbean-chat

build.dockerfile:
FROM node:24-slim AS frontend
ARG BRIGHTBEAN_REF=7bf959b30cc7f345f84d2be59e68a0a05c327e4f
ADD https://codeload.github.com/brightbeanxyz/brightbean-chat/tar.gz/${BRIGHTBEAN_REF} /src.tar.gz
RUN mkdir /app && tar -xzf /src.tar.gz -C /app --strip-components=1
WORKDIR /app
RUN npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
RUN npm run build:css && test -s apps/theme/static/css/dist/styles.css
RUN npm run build:js && test -s apps/flows/static/flows/builder/builder.js && test -s apps/flows/static/flows/builder/builder.css

FROM python:3.12-slim AS builder
ENV PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1 PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1
RUN python -m venv /opt/venv
ENV PATH="/opt/venv/bin:$PATH"
ARG BRIGHTBEAN_REF=7bf959b30cc7f345f84d2be59e68a0a05c327e4f
ADD https://codeload.github.com/brightbeanxyz/brightbean-chat/tar.gz/${BRIGHTBEAN_REF} /src.tar.gz
RUN mkdir /app && tar -xzf /src.tar.gz -C /app --strip-components=1
WORKDIR /app
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --default-timeout=120 --retries 8 -r requirements/base.txt

FROM python:3.12-slim AS runtime
ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 PORT=8000 MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 PATH="/opt/venv/bin:$PATH"
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && groupadd --system --gid 1001 app \
    && useradd --system --uid 1001 --gid app --home-dir /app --shell /usr/sbin/nologin app
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /opt/venv /opt/venv
COPY --from=builder --chown=app:app /app /app
COPY --from=frontend --chown=app:app /app/apps/theme/static/css/dist /app/apps/theme/static/css/dist
COPY --from=frontend --chown=app:app /app/apps/flows/static/flows/builder /app/apps/flows/static/flows/builder
COPY --chown=app:app brightbean-chat/openship_settings.py /app/config/settings/openship.py
COPY --chown=app:app brightbean-chat/openship_adapter.py /app/apps/accounts/openship_adapter.py
RUN mkdir -p /app/staticfiles /app/media && chown app:app /app /app/staticfiles /app/media
USER app
RUN DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings.openship SECRET_KEY=collectstatic-build-placeholder ENCRYPTION_KEY_SALT=collectstatic-build-placeholder APP_URL=https://build.invalid DJANGO_ENV_FILE=/nonexistent python manage.py collectstatic --noinput --clear
EXPOSE 8000

files.content:
import os
from urllib.parse import urlparse

# Open-ship install: the public host comes from APP_URL. This runs before the
# production settings import, which refuses to boot without ALLOWED_HOSTS.
_url = urlparse(os.environ.get("APP_URL", ""))
_hosts = [h for h in [_url.hostname, "127.0.0.1", "localhost"] if h]
os.environ.setdefault("ALLOWED_HOSTS", ",".join(_hosts))
if _url.scheme and _url.netloc:
    os.environ.setdefault("CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS", f"{_url.scheme}://{_url.netloc}")

from .production import *  # noqa: E402,F401,F403

ACCOUNT_ADAPTER = "apps.accounts.openship_adapter.OpenshipAccountAdapter"

# HTTPS-only behaviour stays on whenever APP_URL is https; a plain-http (port
# mode) install turns the redirect and secure cookies off so it can be used.
if _url.scheme != "https":
    SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT = False
    SECURE_HSTS_SECONDS = 0
    SECURE_HSTS_INCLUDE_SUBDOMAINS = False
    SECURE_HSTS_PRELOAD = False
    SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE = False
    CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE = False

entrypointArgv:
set -e
python manage.py migrate --noinput
python manage.py process_tasks & worker=$!
gunicorn config.wsgi:application --bind 0.0.0.0:8000 --workers 2 --threads 2 & web=$!
trap 'kill $worker $web 2>/dev/null' TERM INT
wait -n $worker $web
code=$?
kill $worker $web 2>/dev/null
exit $code

connection.title: Create your BrightBean Chat account
connection.description: There is no preset login. Open the address below and create the first account at /accounts/signup/; it becomes the owner and sign-up then closes. Add your own developer credentials for each messaging platform before connecting channels.

firstLogin.note: Create the first account straight after install: until it exists, anyone who can reach the address can claim the instance.
